1" PEX supply and return pair, HS-1 to MF-1: about 41' each way, 2.0 gpm, under the boards, insulated end to end.
1" PEX supply and return pair, HS-1 to MF-2 and MF-G: about 27' each way, 2.9 gpm, under the boards, insulated end to end.
1" PEX supply and return pair, HS-1 to MF-K: about 17' each way, 1.5 gpm, under the boards, insulated end to end.
1" PEX supply and return pair, HS-1 to MF-5: about 12' each way, 1.7 gpm, under the boards, insulated end to end.
1" PEX supply and return pair, HS-1 to MF-4: about 43' each way, 1.5 gpm, under the boards, insulated end to end.
1" PEX supply and return pair, HS-1 to MF-3: about 52' each way, 2.3 gpm, under the boards, insulated end to end.

MF-1: 7-loop stainless manifold with flow meters and 24 V actuators, laundry, on the north wall west of the dryer. Surface-mounted manifold cabinet on the laundry's north wall, between the linen alcove and the dryer. That wall is the staggered-stud sound wall to the master bed, so the cabinet is not recessed. The master bed, bath and hall loops come under that wall straight up into it; the closet, bath and laundry loops come up from the laundry side.

MF-2: 3-loop stainless manifold with flow meters and 24 V actuators, mud room, on the south wall (garage wall), west end. Surface-mounted cabinet on the mud room side of the garage wall, back to back with MF-G; the feed pair rises in that wall and serves both.

MF-G: 11-loop stainless manifold with flow meters and 24 V actuators, garage, on the mud room wall (two 7-loop manifolds side by side). Surface-mounted cabinets on the garage face of the mud room wall, 4' above the slab, back to back with MF-2, with the garage's own pump P-RG and mixing valve. Surface mounting keeps the garage fire separation whole.

MF-K: 5-loop stainless manifold with flow meters and 24 V actuators, mud room, east wall (kitchen wall), south of the powder room. Recessed cabinet in the mud room side of the kitchen wall. The kitchen and dining loops come under that wall, under the base cabinets south of the range, straight into it.

MF-5: 7-loop stainless manifold with flow meters and 24 V actuators, pantry, on the east wall (entry wall). Recessed cabinet in the pantry side of the entry wall. The entry, office and living room loops come under that wall straight into it; the pantry loop comes up on the pantry side. Ten feet of 1" feed from HS-1 under the pantry floor.

MF-3: 8-loop stainless manifold with flow meters and 24 V actuators, bedroom hall, west wall north of the fireplace. Recessed manifold cabinet in the hall's west wall between the living room opening and the fireplace chase. A 2x4 wall takes a 3-1/2" deep cabinet; fur it to 2x6 locally if the chosen manifold needs more (S-1).

MF-4: 6-loop stainless manifold with flow meters and 24 V actuators, bedroom hall, west wall south of the fireplace. Recessed cabinet in the hall's west wall south of the fireplace chase, across from the bath 2 door. The living room's east loops come under that wall straight into it.
HS-1, condensing boiler for the slab, with the system pump, mixing and the zone controller
T1, zone 1 thermostat (Master suite): Master bed, interior wall by the hall door.
T2, zone 2 thermostat (Great room and utility): Kitchen side of the living room, on the entry wall, away from the fireplace and the patio glass.
T3, zone 3 thermostat (Bedroom wing and office): Bedroom hall, south end.
TG, zone G thermostat (Garage (held at 50°F)): Garage, wall by the mud room door.

svg.text: leaders, supply and return side by side 3" apart
1" feed pair from HS-1, under the boards
manifold cabinet over its row of 3" ports
4' x 4' nub boards in a running bond from the datum; dots are the 3" puck grid

47 loops, 5,957' of 1/2" PEX, 7 manifolds, no loop over 200'. · Red zone 1, orange zone 2, blue zone 3, green garage. · 52 kBtu/h at design, 110°F supply. · EPS25 Super 4 nub boards on the 3" grid from the datum; nothing
